confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live listing checks. Restaurant and beer anchors are medium confidence; cocktail and wine are inferred from the local beer and restaurant price relationship; hostel and hotel tiers are lower confidence because July is low season and current Kampot accommodation rates are uncertain. The FX value comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA overview page and was not independently opened, so verify it against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Cambodian provincial tourism towns (such as Battambang and Kep), adjusted for Kampot's riverside café and restaurant scene and its backpacker and expat accommodation market. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
